description: Land Acquisition - Olaboduwa, Thalagala, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act for a public purpose (Ruwanpura Expressway Project). It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
